title: Pip and the Puddle Path
note: b417 — Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new alternative pronunciations i as igh, o as oa, o as u, u as oo.

pages.brief: Pip the sparrow walking along a path dotted with small puddles after rain.
Pip the sparrow noticing a small shiny red bug floating on the surface of a puddle.
Pip the sparrow tilting his head, looking curiously at the unfamiliar bug.
Pip the sparrow pecking gently and cautiously at the red bug.
Pip the sparrow jumping back with a startled expression, beak open wide.
Pip the sparrow shaking his head, the red bug dropping back into the puddle water.
Pip the sparrow hopping along the path, looking around for something else to eat.
Pip the sparrow spotting a plump seed lying on the dry part of the path.
Pip the sparrow happily pecking at the seed, clearly enjoying it.
Pip the sparrow standing contentedly on the path, puddles glinting behind him.
